display.purpose: Cover name and section headings; 900 weight does the work.

body.purpose: All prose; one family, weight carries hierarchy.

label.purpose: Compartment headers and chips only; never an eyebrow above a heading.

motion.name: piece-drop
motion.purpose: Diagram pieces drop into their seats on load; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: piece-lift
motion.purpose: Hover raises a piece off the page; its shadow stays.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Action-blue keyline button for the main action of a section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--action-blue, #147bd1); color: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--keyline, #111111); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--keyline, #111111); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 24px; font: 700 16px 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action-blue, #147bd1); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Paper keyline button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #10151b); border: 2px solid var(--keyline, #111111); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--keyline, #111111); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 24px; font: 700 16px 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Email Button
components.description: Piece-red button reserved for the email action.
components.css: .ds-btn-email { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--piece-red, #e53935); color: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--keyline, #111111); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--keyline, #111111); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 24px; font: 700 16px 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-email:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Marker-yellow chip naming an article category.
components.css: .ds-chip-category { display: inline-block; background: var(--marker, #ffcd00); color: var(--ink, #10151b); border: 2px solid var(--keyline, #111111); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; font: 900 11px/1.2 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Piece Chip
components.description: Paper chip listing a piece a step added.
components.css: .ds-chip-piece { display: inline-block; background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #10151b); border: 2px solid var(--keyline, #111111); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 600 14px 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: The universal container: paper, keyline, hard offset.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--paper, #ffffff); border: 2px solid var(--keyline, #111111); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--keyline, #111111); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px 28px; font-family: 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #10151b); } .ds-card h3 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card p { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary, #33404e); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Keyline text input with leading icon.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #10151b); border: 2px solid var(--keyline, #111111); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--keyline, #111111); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font: 600 14px 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action-blue, #147bd1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #4a5b6b); }

components.name: TOC Dock
components.description: Collapsible bottom-center contents pill for articles.
components.css: .ds-dock { position: fixed; bottom: 16px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: var(--paper, #ffffff); border: 2px solid var(--keyline, #111111); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--keyline, #111111); border-radius: 16px; font-family: 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dock-toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; } .ds-dock-brick { width: 16px; height: 16px; background: var(--piece-red, #e53935); border: 2px solid var(--keyline, #111111); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-dock-title { font: 700 14px 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #10151b); }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: Slightly rotated certificate stamp with dashed inner border.
components.css: .ds-stamp { background: var(--paper, #ffffff); border: 2px solid var(--keyline, #111111); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--keyline, #111111); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; transform: rotate(-1.2deg); transition: transform 150ms ease-out; font-family: 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stamp:hover { transform: rotate(0deg); } .ds-stamp-inner { border: 2px dashed var(--ghost-blue, #7fa8cc); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; } .ds-stamp-issuer { font: 900 11px/1.2 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--piece-red, #e53935); margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-stamp-name { font: 800 14px/1.3 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 0 6px; color: var(--ink, #10151b); } .ds-stamp-detail { font: 400 12px/1.5 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text-secondary, #33404e); margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: The site is a brick build-instruction manual for an engineer. Every page is a printed instruction sheet: sky-blue paper, black keylines, chunky rounded numerals, and colored pieces showing what each step adds. Projects are taught, not listed. The dark theme is the same booklet under a work lamp. Depth is printed, not lit: hard black offsets, zero blur. No monospace anywhere — the terminal aesthetic of the previous design is the explicit anti-reference.
keyCharacteristics: 2px black keyline on every interactive or container element
Hard offset shadows (0 2–4px 0 keyline, zero blur); hover lifts the piece
Sky-blue page ground, white paper cards, four piece colors with fixed roles
Giant 900-weight numerals as section and step markers
Isometric brick diagrams annotated with leader lines and dashed guides
One authored motion: pieces drop into their seats on load

rules.name: The Piece Rule
rules.body: Red marks the piece a step adds; yellow marks where the build stands; blue works the controls. A color never borrows another's job.

rules.name: The Keyline Rule
rules.body: Every interactive element and container carries a 2px keyline border and a hard offset shadow. If it has no keyline, it is not part of the kit.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Rubik carries every role from hero to chip text. Weight 400–900, nothing else.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Separator Rule
rules.body: Section dividers are 2px keyline lines spanning the entire viewport width, never stopping at the container edge.

dos: Do keep every claim next to its artifact link — evidence is the design.
Do use dashed keylines for guides, seats, and ghost states.
Do keep dark mode as the navy work-lamp booklet with the same piece hues.
Do theme browser chrome from the palette: selection marker-yellow, focus blue, scrollbars plate-gray.
donts: Don't reintroduce the old anti-references: pulsing status dots, // section labels, uppercase tracking-widest micro-labels, mono type, fake ID cards, STATUS: ACTIVE rows.
Don't use blur or ambient shadows; the only shadow is the hard keyline offset.
Don't add a second display face or a serif; Rubik does everything.
Don't use red or yellow as body-text colors on the sky ground — contrast fails; they mark pieces, not prose.
